title: Keep discriminated unions intact through helper transforms
description: Maps a union response through a helper that strips the discriminant.
issue_title: Helper erases the discriminant needed downstream
issue_description: Once the branch marker is removed, callers can no longer narrow the result safely.
issue_suggestion: Preserve or reintroduce a discriminant in the transformed return type.

title: Type recursive config merges without losing optional branches
description: Deep-merges user config into defaults and asserts the result as the final type.
issue_title: Shallow merge plus assertion hides broken nested config
issue_description: The cast claims nested branches are complete even though the spread is only shallow.
issue_suggestion: Use a real deep merge or validate the merged result before returning Config.

title: Do not index generic rows with unbounded strings
description: Renders a table cell by looking up a field on a generic row.
issue_title: Generic key is not constrained to the row shape
issue_description: Any string is accepted even if the property does not exist on the generic row.
issue_suggestion: Constrain the key to keyof T and type the return accordingly.
issue_code: function renderCell<T, K extends keyof T>(row: T, column: K) {

title: Preserve async iterator item types in stream wrappers
description: Wraps an async generator and returns it as AsyncIterable<any>.
issue_title: Wrapper erases the stream item type
issue_description: Downstream consumers lose the payload contract and can no longer rely on typed items.
issue_suggestion: Return the concrete async iterable type instead of any.

title: Avoid unsound narrowing after array filters
description: Filters nullable users and assumes the result is User[] without a type guard.
issue_title: Boolean filter does not communicate a precise type guard
issue_description: The runtime filter works, but the type can still remain too broad or rely on loose inference.
issue_suggestion: Use an explicit predicate that narrows the array element type.
issue_code: const activeUsers = users.filter((user): user is User => user !== null);

title: Type route builders with template-literal params
description: Builds URLs by string replacement on untyped route templates.
issue_title: Route params are not tied to the route shape
issue_description: Callers can omit required params or provide unrelated keys without compile-time feedback.
issue_suggestion: Use template-literal route types or a typed route map to bind params to each path.

title: Do not mix browser and Node timeout handle types blindly
description: Stores a timeout handle as a number in shared code.
code:
let timer: number | null = null;
timer = setTimeout(() => {}, 1000);
issue_description: Node and browser runtimes expose different timeout handle types, and hard-coding number is not portable.
issue_suggestion: Use ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> for cross-environment timeout handles.
issue_code: let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

title: Model API error codes as a finite union
description: Represents server error codes as generic strings throughout the UI.
code: type ApiError = { code: string; message: string };
issue_title: Error code domain is too broad
issue_description: The compiler cannot help ensure all known error cases are handled when the code field is just string.
issue_suggestion: Model the known error codes as a literal union.

title: Avoid mutating generic defaults through shared references
description: Uses a generic helper with a mutable default object.
issue_title: Default object is mutated across calls
issue_description: The helper creates shared mutable state and hides the type of the meta object.
issue_suggestion: Create a fresh typed object per call instead of mutating a shared default.
issue_code: function withMeta<T>(value: T, meta: Record<string, boolean> = {}) {

title: Keep exhaustiveness checks after refactoring helper maps
description: Maps status values to labels with an object indexed by string.
issue_title: Mapping object does not guarantee full coverage of the status union
issue_description: A missing case returns undefined at runtime even though the domain is finite and known.
issue_suggestion: Type the map against the exact status union so missing cases fail at compile time.
issue_code: const labels: Record<Status, string> = { draft: 'Draft', published: 'Published', archived: 'Archived' };
